status_summary: No bill or SBA action creating a medium-sized business classification was found. SBA's size standard rulemaking in the period addresses small business thresholds only: a proposed rule of 2025-08-22 would raise monetary-based standards for 263 industries, and a proposed rule of 2026-08-20 would set new standards for 338 industry groups at the 4-digit and 5-digit NAICS levels with a single small business threshold per industry and no mid-size category.
